## 2026-10-22 attached-host readiness check (read-only)

- `wsl --version` reports WSL `3.0.3.0`; `wslc.exe --version` reports WSLc `3.0.3.0` on this Windows host.
- A read-only `Win32_Process` snapshot found no visible `wslc.exe` processes at the time of inspection.
- No WSLc container/image inventory or run, Docker command, cleanup, or allocation was performed.

This does **not** establish that the shared WSLc runtime has no existing containers, that their ownership is reconciled, or that a named allocation is unused. Keep the STOP/HOLD disposition and do not start the repo smoke or experiment until the shared owners are reconciled or an allocator confirms a specific unused slot. The version observation does not update or replace any earlier experiment result.

interpretation: No explicit specific-unused-WSLc-slot confirmation found in the current issue body/latest comments. Runtime execution remains pending a real target allocation; zero-client/distro observations are insufficient.
